mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS couple_id, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS owner_name, u.role AS owner_role FROM couple c INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id IN (c.groom_id, c.bride_id) WHERE c.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (c.groom_id = #{userId} OR c.bride_id = #{userId}) AND u.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.id ASC

SELECT c.id AS card_id, COALESCE(linked_cp.id, matched_cp.id) AS card_product_id, COALESCE(linked_cp.company, matched_cp.company, c.company) AS company, COALESCE(c.card_name, linked_cp.name, matched_cp.name) AS card_name, COALESCE(linked_cp.image, matched_cp.image) AS image, COALESCE(linked_cp.annual_fee, matched_cp.annual_fee, 0) AS annual_fee, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(COALESCE(linked_cp.benefit, matched_cp.benefit), '$')) AS benefit, COALESCE(linked_cp.`condition`, matched_cp.`condition`) AS condition_text, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(linked_cp.updated_at, matched_cp.updated_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS condition_checked_at FROM card c LEFT JOIN card_product matched_cp ON matched_cp.id = ( SELECT cp2.id FROM card_product cp2 WHERE ( REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(cp2.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(c.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', '') OR REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(c.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(cp2.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', ''), '%') OR REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(cp2.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(c.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', ''), '%') ) AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(cp2.name, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', ''), '-', ''), '_', ''), '.', ''), '/', ''), '[', ''), ']', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(c.card_name, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', ''), '-', ''), '_', ''), '.', ''), '/', ''), '[', ''), ']', '') ORDER BY cp2.updated_at DESC, cp2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND c.card_product_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN card_product linked_cp ON linked_cp.id = c.card_product_id WHERE c.id = #{cardId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM card cd INNER JOIN couple co ON co.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (cd.user_id = co.groom_id OR cd.user_id = co.bride_id) WHERE cd.id = #{cardId} AND (co.groom_id = #{userId} OR co.bride_id = #{userId})
SELECT cp.id FROM card_product cp WHERE cp.company = #{company} AND cp.name = #{name} ORDER BY cp.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_product ( company, name, annual_fee, image, benefit, `condition` ) VALUES ( #{source.company}, #{source.name}, #{source.annualFee}, #{source.image}, #{source.benefit}, #{source.conditionText} )
mapper.update: UPDATE card_product SET annual_fee = #{source.annualFee}, image = #{source.image}, benefit = #{source.benefit}, `condition` = #{source.conditionText}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE company = #{source.company} AND name = #{source.name}

UPDATE card c INNER JOIN card_product cp ON cp.company = #{source.company} AND cp.name = #{source.name} SET c.card_product_id = cp.id WHERE c.card_product_id IS NULL AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(c.card_name, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', ''), '-', ''), '_', ''), '.', ''), '/', ''), '[', ''), ']', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(#{source.name}, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', ''), '-', ''), '_', ''), '.', ''), '/', ''), '[', ''), ']', '') AND ( REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(c.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(#{source.company}, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', '') OR REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(c.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(#{source.company}, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', ''), '%') OR REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(#{source.company}, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(c.company, '')), ' ', ''), '카드', ''), '%') )
